content: Protocol and current implementation sources favor deterministic relay/follow-set feeds and signed lists over opaque ranking. Pyramid offers main, favorites, popular, uppermost, moderated and inbox subrelays plus negentropy sync; Jumble community mode can expose configured relay sets; NIP-51 curation sets and relay sets make portable editorial lists possible, though client UX is uneven. Public-event aggregation should initially query configured sources rather than copy events; any materialized cache needs provenance, dedupe, NIP-09/NIP-62 propagation and strict exclusion of private relays/events. Flotilla provides directory, polls, events, search and featured content, but no generic binding governance standard exists.
